The difference vanishes near every insertion and has compact support, so this integration by parts has no contact or infinity boundary term. Take V homogeneous of degree i = 0 or 1 and shrink χ to radius rm. Changing variables y = x0+rmz in (SC9) gives the factor r3+i m : four powers from volume, minus one from differentiating the cutoff, and i from V . Choose h = 3 + i in (SC8). Its bound times the finite integral of |∂aχ(z)Vb(z)| tends to zero. Therefore every finite linear relation among the ordinary D-field exterior readings is satisfied by the flux readings, with D = d + 1 for translations and D = d for rotations.
